Report xMetrics coverage of each competition-season's minutes (R079)

Source: R/spm_opta.R
dot-report_xmetrics_coverage.Rd

SPM imputes xg/npxg/xa to 0 for a player with no xMetrics row, so a competition-season whose xMetrics never got built silently trains as "nobody shot". Coverage is all-or-nothing in practice (2026-10-14: 562 of 894 competition-seasons at exactly 0%, the rest at 100%), mostly seasons before xMetrics starts (2013-14) and Scottish 2014-15 to 2018-19. This prints one summary of the uncovered seasons of competitions that DO have xMetrics elsewhere, and raises a GitHub Actions warning only when one of them is among the latest recent_seasons – the case that means a build failed rather than a known historical gap. It never changes data.

Usage

.report_xmetrics_coverage(
  opta_stats,
  opta_xmetrics,
  recent_seasons = 2L,
  floor = 0.8
)

Arguments

opta_stats

Player-match stats with player_id, competition, season and a minutes column.

opta_xmetrics

xMetrics season table with player_id, season and either competition (Opta name) or league (panna code, as step 01 adds).

recent_seasons

Number of latest season end years that warn.

floor

Share of minutes below which a competition-season counts as uncovered.

Value

The coverage table (competition, season, minutes, share), invisibly; NULL when either input lacks the needed columns.
